Class TelemetryEvent

java.lang.Object
comp3607project.TelemetryEvent
public class TelemetryEvent extends Object
Represents one timestamped telemetry event and its optional compilation, execution, editor-activity or class metadata.

This documentation is generated from a separate copy of the submitted source. The original project source files are not modified.
